families.family_name: Family 1: Core Conversational REPL & Streaming UX
families.family_description: Lifecycle of conversational turns, streaming token buffers, typewriter rendering, thinking/reasoning blocks, structured diff previews, interruption, and transcript management.

capabilities.name: Session Creation & Initialization
capabilities.claude_frontend_behavior: App mounts -> generates session UUID -> loads config/theme -> initializes REPL state -> displays LogoV2 banner
capabilities.decision_rationale: Local interaction model is completely self-contained in TS shell and adheres to canonical Claude UX.

capabilities.name: Resume Past Session (/resume)
capabilities.claude_frontend_behavior: User triggers /resume -> reads project session logs -> presents interactive LogSelector -> user selects turn -> recovers messages and cost state -> mounts REPL
capabilities.decision_rationale: Adapt LogSelector to discover and load stored sessions from Brain's SQLite event log in addition to legacy JSONL files.

capabilities.name: Token Streaming & Typewriter Drain
capabilities.claude_frontend_behavior: Query executes -> receives stream events -> buffers in TypewriterQueue -> renders incremental text deltas -> autoscrolls VirtualMessageList
capabilities.brain_replacement_implementation: crates/brain-services UDS monotonic StreamEvent chunks via packages/brain-shell/src/adapter/brainCallModel.ts
capabilities.decision_rationale: Preserve Claude streaming UI and typewriter queue while powering token generation directly from Brain's UDS daemon.

capabilities.name: Reasoning & Thinking Blocks (ThinkingConfig)
capabilities.claude_frontend_behavior: Receives `thinking` stream events -> renders collapsible ThinkingBlock with elapsed timer -> captures signature -> collapses on text_delta start
capabilities.decision_rationale: Preserve collapsible thinking box UI while receiving native reasoning stream chunks from Brain backend.

capabilities.name: Structured Diff Rendering
capabilities.claude_frontend_behavior: Computes file patch delta -> tokenizes line changes -> highlights intra-line word diffs -> renders unified or side-by-side box with red/green backgrounds
capabilities.decision_rationale: Local interaction model is completely self-contained in TS shell and adheres to canonical Claude UX.

capabilities.name: Response Interruption & Cancellation (Ctrl+C / Escape)
capabilities.claude_frontend_behavior: User presses cancel key -> CancelRequestHandler triggers AbortController.abort() -> query loop halts -> appends InterruptedByUser notice -> resets composer
capabilities.brain_replacement_implementation: AbortSignal propagation over UDS socket to cancel active Brain task
capabilities.decision_rationale: Propagate AbortController cancellation from Claude UI directly to Rust UDS daemon task cancellation.
